title: Microsoft Teams: organisation-wide meeting and call troubleshooting in the Teams admin center
summary: Pass: the rollout facts, navigation paths, commands and licence-dependent telemetry periods are supported. The sources do not explicitly establish the claimed read-only guarantee, and the Administrative Unit checklist instruction has no corresponding controls row.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an organisation-wide meeting and call monitoring pane in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation

claims.claim: The roadmap describes uncovering recurring meeting and call health patterns.
claims.quote: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns

claims.claim: The roadmap describes troubleshooting active and completed meetings and calls.
claims.quote: proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2026.

claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late September 2026 and is expected to complete by mid October 2026.

claims.claim: Learn describes interconnected user, meeting and participant views.

claims.claim: Tenant-scope role assignment is at Microsoft Entra admin center > Identity > Roles & admins > role > Add assignments.
claims.quote: Browse to **Identity** > **Roles & admins**. ... Select a role name to open the role. ... Select **Add assignments**

claims.claim: New-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleAssignment with DirectoryScopeId '/', PrincipalId and RoleDefinitionId assigns a tenant-scope directory role.
claims.quote:
$directoryScope = '/'
$roleAssignment = New-MgRoleManagementDirectoryRoleAssignment `
   -DirectoryScopeId $directoryScope -PrincipalId $user.Id `
   -RoleDefinitionId $roleDefinition.Id

claims.where: controls[1].ui; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Learn's per-user route is Teams admin center > Manage users > user > Meetings & calls.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select **Manage users**. Select the user whose meetings you want to troubleshoot. ... Select the **Meetings & calls** tab

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: GET /v1.0/communications/callRecords is an existing Microsoft Graph call records feed.
claims.quote: Get the list of callRecord objects and their properties. ... GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/communications/callRecords

claims.quote: | Application | CallRecords.Read.All | Not available. |

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI switch or automation to enable or disable the organisation-wide Meetings & Calls pages is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "single pane" "PowerShell" "disable"; "Teams admin center" "monitoring" "Graph" "switch". Opened meeting troubleshooting, Teams roles and Graph callRecords pages; no pane switch found.

claims.claim: The cited Learn troubleshooting article does not give the notice's Meetings & Calls > Meetings route.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center organization wide meetings calls troubleshooting roles administrative units support specialist. Opened the full Monitor and troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls article; its navigation starts at Manage users and contains no Meetings & Calls > Meetings path.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Quality and reliability issues replace the previous Good or Poor labels.
claims.quote: Meeting and call quality is no longer categorized as Good or Poor. Instead, you can now check if the user faced any quality or reliability issues in the meeting.

claims.claim: Intelligent media classifiers judge media quality after the meeting finishes and telemetry is aggregated.
claims.quote: Once a meeting is complete and the telemetry is aggregated, media quality is judged using intelligent media classifiers.

claims.claim: A highlighted telemetry value does not necessarily mean poor user-experienced quality.
claims.quote: A value being highlighted doesn't necessarily mean the user experienced poor quality, but can help identify potential risks worth additional investigation.

claims.claim: An in-progress issue does not necessarily mean the user experienced degraded quality.
claims.quote: Since these values are general targets based on expected performance, the existence of an issue doesn't necessarily mean the user experienced degraded media quality.

claims.claim: Participant information includes location based on public IP.
claims.quote: Location based on public IP

claims.quote: For federated and external participants, end-user identifiable information (EUII) is obfuscated to protect privacy in accordance with Microsoft data handling policies.

claims.quote: For peer-to-peer (P2P) calls, relevant EUII is **not** obfuscated because the shared call session requires participant information to support effective troubleshooting.

claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center meeting troubleshooting export permission audit events viewing exported meeting data; "Teams" "troubleshooting" "export" "permission". Opened troubleshooting and Teams roles pages; no separate export permission or setting found.

claims.quote: If your organization uses Administrative Units (AUs), your AU assignment determines which users' meetings you can access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified how Administrative Unit scoping applies to the new organisation-wide lists.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center organization wide meetings calls troubleshooting roles administrative units support specialist. Read troubleshooting, Teams roles and Administrative units for Microsoft Teams excerpts; no explicit new-list scoping found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature is a read-only view with no change to autonomy or actions.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams admin center" "meetings" "read-only" "troubleshooting". Opened Monitor and troubleshoot Teams meetings and calls and read MC1462463; both describe monitoring, diagnostics and Copilot analysis, but neither explicitly guarantees read-only behaviour.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the sources describe a read-only monitoring and troubleshooting view.' with 'The sources describe monitoring, diagnostics and Copilot analysis.' In the risk rationale, replace 'a read-only view of meeting and call telemetry' with 'a view of meeting and call telemetry'.

claims.claim: The Troubleshoot action opens Copilot in a chat window with a prefilled prompt that the administrator runs.
claims.quote: select the **Troubleshoot** table action. Copilot opens in a chat window within the Teams admin center with a prefilled prompt. Just run the prompt and Copilot provides a detailed analysis

claims.claim: In-progress meetings and Completed meetings replace the earlier Recent meetings and Past meetings lists.
claims.quote: In-progress meetings ... earlier these meetings showed up as "Recent meetings" ... Completed meetings ... earlier these meetings showed up as both "Recent meetings" and "Past meetings" depending on user license and elapsed time

claims.claim: Completed-meeting telemetry can take 30 minutes to 2 hours to process.
claims.quote: Once the meeting has ended, it might take from 30 minutes to 2 hours for the telemetry to be processed.

claims.claim: Users whose meetings are investigated must use Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: Users whose meetings you want to investigate must be using Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: The feature article's prerequisite list names no administrator licence.
claims.quote: You have one of the supported admin roles assigned in Microsoft Entra ID. ... your AU assignment determines which users' meetings you can access. ... Partner admins using Granular Delegated Admin Privileges ... Users whose meetings you want to investigate must be using Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: Aggregated telemetry is available for all users for 30 days after the meeting.

claims.claim: The sources publish no feature-specific price, meter or Copilot Credits rate for this Copilot analysis.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center meeting troubleshooting Copilot analysis license pricing Copilot Credits meter. Opened troubleshooting and Understand usage-based billing and cost management for Copilot Credits; no rate or meter for this analysis found.

claims.quote: In-progress meeting data includes all users regardless of license type, while the meeting is live.

claims.where: Scope: Licence differences to reconcile; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Microsoft has not explained how the notice's premium-participant condition and Learn's all-users statement fit together.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center meeting troubleshooting Copilot analysis license pricing Copilot Credits meter. Read MC1462463 and the full troubleshooting article; no reconciliation of the two in-progress conditions found.

claims.claim: The checked documentation does not specify which roles can reach the new organisation-wide Meetings and Calls lists.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center organization wide meetings calls troubleshooting roles administrative units support specialist. Opened troubleshooting and Teams administrator roles pages; no role-by-role access rules for the new organisation-wide lists found.

claims.claim: The roles page limits Teams Communications Support Specialist's user-information view to the specific searched user.
claims.quote: Teams Communications Support Specialist ... Access user profile page for troubleshooting calls in Call Analytics. Can only view user information for the specific user being searched for.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not identified Graph call records or its permissions as the backing implementation of the new pane.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center monitoring Graph switch; Teams admin center organization-wide Meetings Calls monitoring troubleshooting. Opened the full troubleshooting article and List callRecords; neither identifies callRecords as the pane's data source or permission model.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents no audit event specifically for opening or exporting this meeting troubleshooting data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams admin center" "meeting troubleshooting" "audit". Opened troubleshooting and Audit log activities; searched the activity reference for call analytics, meeting export/telemetry/troubleshooting and viewing calls. No matching access/export event found.

claims.claim: The sources describe an administrator-facing change, not an end-user experience change.
claims.quote:
Who is affected

- Teams administrators responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting meeting and call quality across their organization.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every governance checklist control has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Confirm how Administrative Unit scoping behaves for delegated admins before you rely on it. ... Controls rows cover tenant role assignment, the troubleshooting route/call records feed and the tenant-wide switch; none covers Administrative Unit scoping.
claims.fix: The At rollout instruction to confirm Administrative Unit scoping has no corresponding controls-table row; remove that checklist instruction rather than adding an unverified control row.
